content.comment_body: I am currently developing a program that manages time/duration and temperature using numeric input fields on a [company_name] screen. I have found a way to adjust the time with an off-delay function, but I am not sure how to handle the temperature adjustment. At the moment, I am attempting to use an analog threshold trigger for temperature control. Any suggestions would be appreciated.
Without more details about your program, including the specific logic blocks you are using and how they're connected, it is challenging to provide accurate assistance.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are integrating a [company_name] HMI with [product_name] to control temperature and duration via numeric input fields. The main challenge is the lack of clear instructions for configuring temperature control using analog threshold blocks. While duration control is working, users are struggling to link HMI numeric inputs to analog logic for temperature management within the software. This discussion highlights common usability issues and the need for better documentation or practical examples for such configurations.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for an easy way to set up numeric HMI inputs to adjust temperature settings in the software using logical blocks. They expect straightforward configuration and clear guidance for handling analog values, similar to the process used for time or duration control.
